description: This file provides helper functions for resource block (RB) and virtual resource block (VRB) conversions, as well as functions to find empty RB intervals, used in 5G NR scheduling and resource allocation.

methods.name: crb_to_vrb_dl_non_interleaved
methods.description: Converts CRB interval to VRB interval based on DCI format and search space type.

methods.name: crb_to_vrb_ul_non_interleaved
methods.description: Converts CRB interval to VRB interval for uplink non-interleaved case.

methods.name: vrb_to_crb_ul_non_interleaved
methods.description: Converts VRB interval to CRB interval for uplink non-interleaved case.

methods.name: find_next_empty_interval
methods.description: Finds the next contiguous range of RBs with bits set to zero within specified limits.

methods.name: find_empty_interval_of_length
methods.description: Finds a range of contiguous RBs of specified maximum length with bits set to zero, or the longest possible.
